**Cause**  
The shortfall was caused by a **deduplication‑key defect in the settlement ledger** introduced during a schema migration (v1.8 → v1.9). The key no longer included the order identifier for reversal entries, so each of the 1,914 reversal entries was recorded twice and deducted a second time.

**Size of the shortfall**  
The settlement batch for 5 – 9 March 2026 was short by **INR 4,82,000**.
